cause_quote: The original palette catalog filter used `normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty` on the query and label before `label.includes(query)`, so precomposed and decomposed spellings of the same name failed to match.
user_saw: Searches omitted matching command-palette entries, Signal aliases, and Codex CLI sessions when the query and stored text used different Unicode forms of the same characters.
summary: The fix lowercases and NFC-normalizes both sides of local comparisons in the command palette, Signal alias directory, and Codex CLI session search.
reasoning: The cited commit introduced command-palette catalog search with this comparison, and its lowercase helper only trimmed and lowercased the text. Signal alias search independently shipped with `!alias.includes(query)` in #95738. The Codex comparison already existed at the shallow boundary, and the available offline history could not verify its introducing commit.
